name: io.github.creative-int/abbie
description: Operate Abbie Projects, Workspaces, and governed Tasks through the authenticated MCP bridge.

mcp.name: abbie
mcp.notes: Clients connect through `abbie mcp serve`. `abbie account login` obtains the operator token, stores it in the local credential backend, and the stdio bridge forwards it as a bearer without exposing it to plugin manifests.

computer.abbie/cli-bridge.authentication: The installed Abbie CLI reads the operator token locally; plugin manifests contain no credential.
